checks.name: CK_AppExternalIdentities_Validity
checks.sql: (LinkMethod = 'Admin' AND LinkedByUserId IS NOT NULL) OR LinkMethod = 'Bootstrap'

checks.name: CK_EmploymentPeriods_AccountDecision
checks.sql: AccountDecision IN ('Reuse','Replace') OR AccountDecision IS NULL

checks.name: CK_Requests_OneDriveRetentionAction
checks.sql: OneDriveRetentionAction IN ('AssignToManager','Retain','Delete') OR OneDriveRetentionAction IS NULL

checks.name: CK_Requests_TerminationType
checks.sql: TerminationType IN ('Voluntary','Involuntary','Retirement','Deceased') OR TerminationType IS NULL

checks.name: CK_Requests_MailboxRetentionAction
checks.sql: MailboxRetentionAction IN ('ForwardToManager','SharedMailbox','Delete') OR MailboxRetentionAction IS NULL

checks.name: CK_RequestApprovals_Decision
checks.sql: Decision IN ('Approved','Rejected') OR Decision IS NULL

checks.name: CK_AuditLog_AffectedSystem
checks.sql: AffectedSystem IN ('AD','EntraID','M365','Exchange','SysAid','App') OR AffectedSystem IS NULL
